trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Remark, read in full. Nine of ten categories clean. The numbered list has four items (not a reflex triple); the two spaced em-dashes are appositive; 'This explains why Phi_1 is a quantum dilogarithm' is an ordinary mathematical connective rather than narrated emphasis. RIGOR PASS on the one checkable numeric: 'for the Borromean rings ... whose archimedean evaluation yields 8G' is CORRECT -- G = Catalan = Cl_2(pi/2) = 0.915965594177 and 8G = 7.32772475342, which I confirmed equals 2*V_oct = 2*3.663862376708876 = 7.32772475342, the hyperbolic volume of the Borromean complement. This is the right value, NOT the live corpus error 8*Cl_2(pi/4) = 7.85497720840. The Hecke relation in item 2 is written sigma_i^2 = h_A sigma_i + 1, matching SS7a with h_A = q - q^{-1}.
trap-negation-contrast.notes: TWO FINDINGS. (1) ITEM 1 IS A CATEGORY ERROR AS WRITTEN: 'The braid group B_n is generated by the Yang-Baxter equation sigma_i sigma_{i+1} sigma_i = sigma_{i+1} sigma_i sigma_{i+1}.' A group is generated by elements and PRESENTED by relations; and the displayed relation is the braid relation, which is the unparametrised cousin of the Yang-Baxter equation, not the equation itself (same overstatement as the parent definition's 'the Yang-Baxter equation in exponential form'). Proposed fix: 'B_n is presented by generators sigma_i subject to the braid relations, the unparametrised form of the Yang-Baxter condition.' (2) The Kashaev-invariant sentence says the state sum 'gives <B_3> whose archimedean evaluation yields 8G'. The volume 8G is recovered from the ASYMPTOTIC growth of the Kashaev invariant at roots of unity (the volume conjecture), not from evaluating the invariant itself; the block elsewhere is careful about exactly this distinction (it names the regulator map B(q) -> R as what sends the algebraic volume to the hyperbolic one), so the shortcut here is out of step with its own paragraph.
